definitions.explanation: Describes behavior, actions, or cultures considered crude, violent, or lacking in civilization. Can describe both people and their actions.

examples.japanese: {野蛮|やばん}な{行為|こうい}は{許|ゆる}されない。
{暴力|ぼうりょく}で{解決|かいけつ}しようとするのは{野蛮|やばん}だ。
examples.english: Trying to solve things with violence is savage.

examples.japanese: そのような{野蛮|やばん}な{風習|ふうしゅう}は{現代|げんだい}では{考|かんが}えられない。
examples.english: Such barbaric customs are unthinkable in modern times.

notes: Can be used as a な-adjective ({野蛮|やばん}な{行為|こうい}) or as a noun ({野蛮|やばん}). The antonym is {文明|ぶんめい} (civilization, civilized). Often used to criticize violent or crude behavior. Note that using this word to describe cultures or peoples can be considered offensive. Related: {野蛮人|やばんじん} (barbarian, savage person) is a strongly derogatory term.
